identify_schema_change.expected_solution: Zulip PR #30301 replaces the integer policy field `Realm.create_public_stream_policy` with a foreign key `Realm.can_create_public_channel_group` pointing to `NamedUserGroup`. The change ships as a 4-migration sequence added under zerver/migrations/: (1) `0532_realm_can_create_public_channel_group` adds the FK column nullable; (2) `0533_set_can_create_public_channel_group` backfills the FK from old policy values (mapping integer enum buckets to NamedUserGroup rows: members/moderators/admins/owners); (3) `0534_alter_realm_can_create_public_channel_group` tightens the column to NOT NULL after backfill; (4) `0535_remove_realm_create_public_stream_policy` drops the old integer column. The model declaration changes in `zerver/models/realms.py`.
evaluation_criteria: Must identify all 4 migrations (0532 through 0535) added under zerver/migrations/ for can_create_public_channel_group
Must reference zerver/models/realms.py as the model declaration site
Must explain the 4-step pattern: add nullable FK → backfill → make NOT NULL → drop old column
Should reference the old field name create_public_stream_policy and the new field name can_create_public_channel_group
